problem: Sources arrive in different formats (CSV and nested JSON)
what_the_pipeline_does: Staging models conform both into typed tables and unnest the JSON applications

problem: No source table is one row per person
what_the_pipeline_does: A canonical person record is built by resolving records across and within systems

problem: Exports show current state only with no history
what_the_pipeline_does: Snapshots capture changes over time into a slowly changing dimension

problem: Rehired employees get a new ID with nothing linking the two records
what_the_pipeline_does: Identity resolution links them by shared email or by same name with sequential employment

problem: One person exists as two candidate records in the recruiting system
what_the_pipeline_does: Deduplication by matching name and standardized phone number

problem: Names differ between systems (nicknames and married names)
what_the_pipeline_does: Matching leads with email so it survives any name change

problem: Two different employees share a name and get colliding work emails
what_the_pipeline_does: Concurrent same-name records are never merged and a uniqueness test enforces it

problem: Department names drift across spellings and casing
what_the_pipeline_does: A mapping table standardizes them with a test that fails on unmapped values

problem: Phone numbers and emails arrive in inconsistent formats
what_the_pipeline_does: Standardized in staging before any matching runs

problem: A candidate marked hired never appears in the HR system
what_the_pipeline_does: The HR system is treated as the system of record for employment
